Name: Willy's Bedroom
Author: OceanSmith
Description:
Adds Willy's bedroom as a new location accessible via the ladder in the fish shop

This mod is based off of the excellent Willy's Home mod by andrewist https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62170806, I've updated the mod for Stardew Valley 1.5, and added some new features

New Features:
Willy's bedroom has been moved to the attic, you can access it by right clicking the ladder, but you must have two hearts with Willy to enter!
Slightly redesigned room with some custom textures such as a single fisherman's bed
Willy's schedule has been modified to make him go to sleep in his bedroom each evening
Some locational messages with interesting flavor text

NOTE: make sure you have content patcher version 1.21 or later, to allow the custom location to load!

The mod this is based off of has open modification permissions, however, if you are the original mod author and would like me to take this down, send me a message and I can do that!

Not compatible with SVE as they do the same thing. This mod was created before SVE added a bedroom for Willy.
